serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
CobbleStone Contract Insight contract management software is delivered as SaaS offering using a multi-tenant public cloud computing environment. It is available to federal, state, local, and tribal governments, as well as research institutions, federal contractors, government contractors, education systems, and more. CobbleStone contract lifecycle management software (CLM) increases efficiency and security with a web-enabled solution that helps users:

* Simplify and enhance the entire contract lifecycle
* Conduct advanced searching and reporting
* Complete tasks and achieve goals with email and calendar alerts for key dates
* Track financials to control spend
* Increase agreement collaboration and visibility
* Improve contract cycle times with automated workflow and electronic signatures
* Contract writing with pre-approved templates and clauses
* Artificial intelligence (AI) data extraction and negotiation with playbooks redlining
* Run advanced reports
* And much more
